# Naive Icons attribution

The site navigation and the three physical island signs share the Book, Grid,
and Tag artwork from `naive-icons` 1.11.0 by Naive Icons / guokaigdg.

- License: MIT; the complete upstream notice is in `LICENSE.txt` beside this file.
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/guokaigdg/naive-icons
- Installed sources: `naive-icons/svg/book.svg`, `grid.svg`, and `tag.svg`.

The original SVG shapes and colors are unchanged. The browser rasterizes these
same icons onto the existing wooden signs. Their SVG bytes participate in the
island source seal so poster captures cannot outlive an icon update.
